who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), round runner for the main agent
where: the round: a lane resolving a merge conflict from files the runner hands it
what: Lane termui wrote its four resolved files against the snapshot of int-1112 the runner saved when the conflict was first seen; five more branches were merged before the resolution came back, and copying the resolved files over dropped three of their changes (home::record in blaze-thin main.rs, UnitOf.primary in print/tests.rs, two decision rows). One build failed on it.
cost: one failed build of the whole tree (about 1 minute) and a merge-fix commit; the dropped decisions.json rows would not have failed any build
whys: the resolved file replaced the tree`s file whole
the lane had only a snapshot, because lanes do not run git
the runner went on merging while the lane wrote
class: a whole-file resolution written against a tree that moved
prevention: apply a lane`s resolution as a three-way merge against the snapshot it was written from (git merge-file with the snapshot as base), never by copying the file; or merge nothing else until the resolution is in
workaround: git diff <snapshot commit> <tip> -- <the resolved files> | git apply --3way
state: open: harness/v2/integrate.py has no step for a lane-written resolution
